meta_title: Cut No Corners | Landscape Gardener Newcastle
meta_description: Cut No Corners is Newcastle's trusted landscape gardener. Expert garden design, hard landscaping, and maintenance. Free quotes available today.
hero_subhead: Transform your garden into a stunning outdoor space. From design to completion, we deliver quality that lasts.
services_heading: Complete Landscape & Garden Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, hard landscaping, or regular maintenance, we handle every detail with precision.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create practical, beautiful gardens that work with your lifestyle and Newcastle's climate.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Expert laying of patios, porcelain, natural stone, and quality decking. Built to last with proper drainage and finishing that elevates your outdoor living.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection and arrangement for year-round colour and texture. We choose hardy varieties suited to the North East and maintain them beautifully.

services.title: Fencing, Walls & Boundaries
services.desc: Strong, attractive fencing and brick or stone walls built to withstand Newcastle winters. We handle design, materials, and installation end-to-end.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Regular upkeep, seasonal pruning, weeding, and lawn care keep your garden looking its best. Monthly or quarterly visits available year-round.

services.title: Driveway & Path Work
services.desc: Professional laying of block paving, tarmac, and natural stone driveways and paths. Safe, even, and built to last in all weather conditions.

about_pullquote: We take pride in every garden — it's about respect, quality, and getting it right.
about_para_1: Cut No Corners was founded on a simple principle: no shortcuts, no excuses. Over 12 years, we've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted team of landscape specialists across Newcastle and the surrounding areas. Every garden we touch reflects our commitment to honest work and genuine craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, deliver on time, and leave their gardens better than we found them. From small borders to complete redesigns, we treat every project with the same care. References and before-and-after photos are always available on request.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Cut No Corners

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our front garden. We wanted a low-maintenance modern look and they absolutely nailed it. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Really happy with the result and the price was fair. Will definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Completely transformed our back garden. We had a rough patio and overgrown borders — now it's a proper outdoor room. They even sorted the drainage issue we didn't know we had. Clearly know their stuff. Top marks.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had them maintain our garden monthly for over a year now. Reliable, consistent, and they remember what we wanted without us repeating ourselves every time. The garden looks better than it ever has. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David L.
